questions.question: Approve the quoted subtitle “Professor of the History of Mathematics” as an informal description: the biography specifies a senior lecturer’s position, not a professorial title. The English subtitle keeps quotation marks and adds no academic degree.

localizations.source: Approve the quoted subtitle “Professor of the History of Mathematics” as an informal description: the biography specifies a senior lecturer’s position, not a professorial title. The English subtitle keeps quotation marks and adds no academic degree.
localizations.ru: Согласовать подзаголовок «профессор истории математики» как неформальную характеристику: в биографии указана должность старшего преподавателя, профессорское звание не заявлено. Английский подзаголовок сохраняет кавычки и не добавляет учёную степень.

questions.question: Clarify the conference count: 2004–2015 inclusive is twelve years, so the total of thirteen apparently includes the 2003 school. Explicitly distinguish that school from the twelve subsequent annual Readings in both languages.

localizations.source: Clarify the conference count: 2004–2015 inclusive is twelve years, so the total of thirteen apparently includes the 2003 school. Explicitly distinguish that school from the twelve subsequent annual Readings in both languages.
localizations.ru: Уточнить счёт конференций: 2004–2015 включительно — двенадцать лет; общее число 13, вероятно, включает школу 2003 года. Предлагается явно разделить школу 2003 года и двенадцать последующих ежегодных чтений в RU/EN.

questions.resolution: The 2003 school is distinguished from the twelve subsequent meetings, as counted in the [proceedings of the thirteenth meeting](https://kolmogorov.yspu.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2016/02/kolmogor13.pdf).
